issues.t: High-voltage battery cells can short internally (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning beforehand. Some trucks show a battery or powertrain warning message.
issues.why: A manufacturing defect inside some high-voltage battery cells can cause an internal short circuit, which raises the risk of a fire. Ford recalled 2022-2024 Lightnings and told owners to charge to no more than 80% until the repair is done.
issues.next: Set your charge limit to 80% and check your VIN for the recall. A Ford dealer will inspect the pack and replace battery arrays for free as needed. If you see smoke or smell burning, get out and away from the truck and call 911.

issues.t: Battery pack can short circuit when fully charged (recall)
issues.sym: A battery warning, or the truck losing power, usually at or near a full charge. Some trucks gave no warning.
issues.why: A defect in some 2023 high-voltage battery packs could cause a short circuit when the battery was full or nearly full, raising fire risk. Ford stopped production and recalled the affected trucks to replace the battery pack.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Until the dealer confirms the work is done, avoid charging to 100% and park outside if you can.

issues.t: Loose bolts inside the battery junction box (recall)
issues.sym: A powertrain or battery warning, the truck going into reduced power, or a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: Some fasteners on the electrical bus bars in the high-voltage battery junction box were not tightened properly. They can arc, which can damage parts, cut drive power and create a fire risk. Ford recalled these trucks, then expanded the recall.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls and have the dealer inspect and repair the junction box for free. If the truck loses power, get off the road safely.

issues.t: Truck may not lock into Park (recall)
issues.sym: You select Park but the truck is not actually held in Park and can roll, especially on a slope.
issues.why: A software problem in the park module can stop the parking pawl from engaging. Ford recalled 2022-2026 Lightnings, along with some Mach-E and Maverick models, for a software update.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake before getting out. Make sure the free software update has been installed, over the air or at a dealer.

issues.t: Front upper ball joint nut may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or knock from the front end, loose or wandering steering, or a change in how the truck tracks. In the worst case a front wheel can partly separate.
issues.why: The nut holding the upper control arm ball joint to the steering knuckle may not have been tightened enough at the factory. Ford recalled 2023-2024 trucks, then added 2024-2025 trucks.
issues.next: If you hear new front-end clunks, stop driving and have it towed in. Check your VIN for both recalls and have the dealer inspect the ball joint nuts for free.

issues.t: Front brake hose can rub the tire and leak (recall)
issues.sym: Brake fluid on the inside of a front wheel, a soft brake pedal, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: Screws holding a front brake hose bracket can come loose, letting the hose touch the tire, wear through, and leak brake fluid.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN for the recall and have the dealer inspect and replace the screws. If the brake pedal feels soft or the brake light comes on, do not drive the truck.

issues.t: Stability control may not turn on (recall)
issues.sym: The stability control light may show it is off, or the truck may feel less stable in slippery conditions or sudden turns.
issues.why: A SYNC software problem could leave electronic stability control turned off at the start of a drive. Ford released an update, then a second recall for trucks where the first fix did not hold.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls and make sure the latest software is installed.

issues.t: Rear lightbar leaks and reverse lights fail (recall)
issues.sym: The reverse lights do not work or flicker, and you may see moisture inside the rear lightbar.
issues.why: Tiny cracks in the rear lightbar lens let water in, which damages the reverse lights. Ford recalled these trucks to replace the lightbar, then recalled trucks again where the first replacement also failed.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recalls and have the lightbar inspected and replaced for free.

issues.t: Weak or no cabin heat and defrost (recall)
issues.sym: The heater blows cold even when set to high, and the windshield will not defrost or defog.
issues.why: The electric cabin coolant heater on some 2023 trucks was missing a solder joint, so it can stop making heat. Without heat, the defroster cannot clear the windshield.
issues.next: Do not drive if you cannot see out of the windshield. Check your VIN for the recall and have the heater replaced for free.

issues.t: Low tire pressure warning may not light up (recall)
issues.sym: A tire can be low on air without the tire pressure warning coming on.
issues.why: On some 2022 trucks with 20- or 22-inch all-season tires, the tire pressure warning was set wrong. A later recall found that some earlier repairs were also done incorrectly.
issues.next: Check your tire pressures with a gauge until the recall is done, and confirm with a dealer that both recall updates were installed.

issues.t: Weak 12V battery causes strange warnings or no start
issues.sym: The truck will not go into Ready or Drive, only powers up in accessory mode, or shows a string of unrelated warnings such as steering assist or frunk faults. Remote start and the FordPass app may stop working.
issues.why: Like most EVs, the Lightning still uses a small 12V battery to wake up its computers. When that battery gets weak or a cable is loose, the truck can act up or refuse to start. Lots of short trips and leaving doors or the frunk open can drain it.
issues.next: Have the 12V battery tested and its cables checked for tightness. A jump start can get you going. If the battery is weak, replacing it usually clears the warnings.

issues.t: High-voltage battery warning or Stop Safely Now message
issues.sym: A battery or powertrain warning, a Stop Safely Now message, reduced power, or the truck shutting down.
issues.why: Ford issued service notes and software updates for 2022-2023 Lightnings with battery energy control module faults, including a voltage unstable fault in the high-voltage battery system.
issues.next: Pull over safely if told to stop. Have a Ford EV dealer read the codes and make sure all battery software updates are installed. Most of this work falls under the 8-year EV battery warranty.

issues.t: Stops charging on a home charger
issues.sym: The truck stops charging partway through on a Level 1 or Level 2 charger, and a warning light or message appears.
issues.why: Ford issued a service note for 2021-2023 Ford EVs, including the Lightning, that can stop charging on AC chargers and set a fault code.
issues.next: Try a different charger and check the charger and outlet. If the truck still stops, have a dealer read the codes and apply the latest software.

issues.t: DC fast charging sessions fail
issues.sym: Charging at public DC fast chargers fails to start or stops early.
issues.why: Ford released a software update for 2022 Lightnings to improve how often DC fast charging sessions succeed.
issues.next: Make sure the truck has the latest software. If problems continue at several different charging stations, have a dealer check the charge port and charging system.

issues.t: Will not charge to 100% after battery balancing
issues.sym: After the truck balances its battery modules, it stops short of a full charge.
issues.why: Ford issued a service note for 2022-2023 Lightnings that cannot reach 100% right after battery cell balancing.
issues.next: This is usually temporary. If it keeps happening, mention the service note to a dealer.

issues.t: Powertrain overheating warning with code P0A3C
issues.sym: A powertrain over-temperature warning or a motor coolant message, sometimes with reduced power.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for 2022-2023 Lightnings that set this over-temperature code. The drive motors and electronics use their own coolant loop.
issues.next: Let the truck cool down, check the coolant level if you can do it safely, and have a dealer apply the bulletin repair.

issues.t: Front trunk (frunk) will not power open or close
issues.sym: The power frunk does not open or close every time, from the button, key fob or app.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for 2022-2024 Lightnings with intermittent frunk power open and close problems, along with software updates to the frunk.
issues.next: Make sure the latest software updates are installed. If it still fails, have a dealer check the frunk using the bulletin.

issues.t: Cabin preconditioning does not run
issues.sym: Scheduled or remote cabin warm-up or cool-down does not happen, so the cabin is cold or hot when you get in.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for Lightnings built before mid-March 2023 where module software stops preconditioning from running.
issues.next: Have a dealer install the software update from the bulletin.

issues.t: Range estimate lower than expected after charging
issues.sym: After charging to 80% or more on a home charger, the range shown is lower than it should be.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for 2022-2023 Lightning Platinum trucks showing too little range after AC charging.
issues.next: Have a dealer apply the bulletin. Remember the range estimate also changes with temperature, speed and towing.

issues.t: ABS and traction control warning lights come on
issues.sym: The ABS and traction control lights come on, with code C1013 stored.
issues.why: Ford issued a service note and a bulletin covering some 2022 Lightnings with these brake warning lights.
issues.next: Your normal brakes should still work, but anti-lock braking may be off. Have a dealer read the codes and apply the bulletin fix soon.

issues.t: Heated steering wheel stops working after remote start
issues.sym: The heated steering wheel does not work after you precondition or remote start the truck.
issues.why: Ford issued a service note for 2022-2023 Lightnings with this fault in the steering column module.
issues.next: Turning the truck fully off and on may bring it back. Ask a dealer about the service note.

issues.t: Large range loss in cold weather
issues.sym: In freezing weather the truck goes much less far on a charge than its rated range, and fast charging is slower.
issues.why: Cold batteries hold and accept less energy, and heating the cabin and battery uses a lot of power. Owners and fleet tests have reported big winter range drops on the Lightning.
issues.next: Precondition the truck while it is plugged in, use the heated seats and wheel instead of high cabin heat, and plan extra charging stops in winter. If range is low in mild weather too, have the battery checked.

issues.t: Power tailgate not closed warning
issues.sym: The dash says the power tailgate is open even though it is closed.
issues.why: Owners report the tailgate latch sensor or wiring giving a false open signal.
issues.next: Make sure the tailgate is fully latched. If the warning stays on, have the tailgate latch and sensor checked.
